Subject: SI-CP-0007 cold plate qualification — request for information (SUP-07)

Dear Oscorp team,

Thank you for your qualification packet for SI-CP-0007, revision A (drawing SI-DWG-CP-0007). To complete our review, please send the following:

1. 1.calibration — Calibration program: your calibration procedure and current calibration records showing coverage of the production gauges used on this part's CTQs.
2. 2.control_plan — Control plan: the control plan for SI-CP-0007 showing how each CTQ (base thickness, port bore, mounting-hole pitch) is controlled.
3. 4.leak_test — Leak test: the helium leak test report for this part, with measured leak rate, test pressure and temperature, against Stark's limit of ≤ 0.000001 mbar·L/s at 6 bar and 20 °C.
4. 5.lot_trace — Lot traceability: a traceability record or procedure demonstrating lot or serial traceability from shipped parts back to raw material.
5. 7.pcn_notice — PCN notice period: your change-notification policy stating the advance notice period in days.

Please reply with the documents referenced by item number.

Regards,
Stark Industries Supplier Quality — Pepper Potts
